I found a plan with 4 paid periods that misses 28 (episode, follower) pairs, the fewest of the schedules I compared. I checked several arrangements by hand rather than every possible schedule, so I cannot prove 28 is the minimum.

**What drives the schedule**
- **One service at a time.** The limit is 1 non-required service on any day.
- **No new access until 29 Nov.**
  - Through 25 Nov, two or more services already have paid access, so no new period may give access on those days.
  - From 26–28 Nov, Northline alone is already at the limit.
  - So the earliest a new period can start is 29 Nov.
- **Covered by existing access.** Lumen (Glass Circuit), the first three Paper Kingdom episodes and the required Pebble Kids titles are already covered.
- **Unavoidable misses (4).** Ivy cannot catch Paper Meridian episodes 1–4, because their windows all end before 29 Nov.

**Why this order**
- **December goes to Marquee.**
  - One period starting by about 4 Dec covers all 8 Paper Meridian episodes for Tom and episodes 5–8 for Ivy, which is 12 pairs.
  - Northline or Orbit in that slot would cover only 4 pairs.
- **After that there are about four one-month slots.**
  - Orbit is mostly needed in January.
  - Northline is needed from late December to mid-March.
  - Marquee must have access on 20–22 Feb so Theo can catch all 8 Crooked Signal episodes (16 pairs including Tom).
- **Comparison with the runner-up.** Giving up Theo's 8 Crooked Signal pairs to fit more Northline time gives 29 misses, so it is worse.

**The plan**

| Period | Service | Pairs it covers |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Dec – 1 Jan | Marquee | All of Tom's Paper Meridian episodes; Ivy's episodes 5–8 |
| 1 Jan – 1 Feb | Orbit | Distant Archive: Ada episodes 5–9, Tom episodes 1–9 |
| 1 Feb – 1 Mar | Marquee | Crooked Signal: all 8 episodes for Theo and for Tom |
| 1 Mar – 1 Apr | Northline | Silver Atlas: Marcus episodes 10–11, Tom episodes 6–11 |

**What is missed (28 pairs)**
- Ivy: Paper Meridian episodes 1–4 (4)
- Ada: Paper Kingdom episodes 4–7 (4)
- Ada: Distant Archive episodes 1–4 and 10 (5)
- Tom: Distant Archive episode 10 (1)
- Marcus: Silver Atlas episodes 1–9 (9)
- Tom: Silver Atlas episodes 1–5 (5)

**Cost:** $13.99 + $10.99 + $13.99 + $11.99 = $50.96, plus the required Pebble Kids renewals, which are not listed.

Periods start on the 1st on purpose: starts on the 29th–31st would end on dates that don't exist in February 2027.
